card: This PR removes an arbitrary upper-bound disconnect timing check in the interface_http.py functional test. The check caused intermittent CI test failures on slow test runners. Precise timeout enforcement remains covered by mock-clock unit tests and existing functional test disconnect expectations. It fixes issue #36755.
evidence: Closes issue #36755 concerning flaky CI failures on slow platforms (PR description)

PR description explains the upper bound 'has led to false negatives in CI on platforms that are just plain slow' and notes that mockable clock unit tests from #36159 already test precise timeout disconnect behavior
problem: The functional test expected the HTTP server to disconnect an idle client after the configured `-rpcservertimeout` but before a fixed upper bound. On slow CI runners, this timing assertion caused flaky false-negative test failures.

risk.why: It only modifies a functional test assertion and touches no node runtime code.

summary: Remove an arbitrary upper-bound execution time check for `-rpcservertimeout` in the `interface_http.py` functional test. The test now avoids timing-sensitive assertions while still ensuring the server disconnects timed-out clients.
